newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bayer plans more small collaborations.
newsitem.headline: Bayer plans more small collaborations.

text.p: German chemicals and drugs group Bayer AG said on Tuesday that it plans to complete several small partnership deals before the end of the year.
"We have several things in the works, but it is too early to say what they will be," Bayer management board chairman Manfred Schneider told a news conference.
He added: "They will certainly be announced before the end of the year, but shouldn't be anything spectacular."
Schneider added that the size of such deals would be small, with the targets posting sales of at least 10 million marks.
He said Bayer is interested in building up its position in eastern Europe. It has just signed three research agreements with three separate institutes in Russia.
Bayer has traditionally preferred to make several smaller acquisitions rather than one single costly deal.
